    LSTMem: Hierarchical Long Short-Term Online Memory for Large Language Models

    LSTMem：面向大型语言模型的分层长短期在线记忆

    Xianglong Shi, Ruijie Yang, Sirui Zhao, Shukang Yin, Zihao Bian, Tinghao Yi, Enhong Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LSTMem introduces gated, hierarchical online memory states that separate history accumulation from readout and improve memory benchmark performance. Its relevance is chiefly memory-system design; reasoning is evaluated as a downstream capability, with no substantive composition or internal-representation analysis.

    LSTMem 引入带门控的分层在线记忆状态，将历史积累与读出分开，并提升记忆基准测试表现。其主要意义在于记忆系统设计；推理是作为下游能力进行评估的，论文没有实质性研究组合能力或内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models increasingly serve as long-horizon assistants and agents, where they must both accumulate information across interactions and make the relevant parts available when later requests depend on them. Existing compact online memories typically use a single persistent state both to accumulate history and to serve readout, so what the memory stores cannot be controlled separately from what it exposes to the current computation. We propose LSTMem, an LSTM-inspired online memory that instead equips each layer of a frozen LLM with two matrix-valued states: a cell state that accumulates history and a hidden state whose readouts correct the backbone's attention. Input and forget gates control what the cell stores, while an output gate separately controls what the cell exposes through the hidden state. LSTMem further connects memory across depth through forward hidden-state propagation and block-end feedback, and uses higher-layer reconstruction gradients to refine lower-layer cell states before rebuilding hidden states from shallow to deep layers. Across memory benchmarks on Qwen3-4B-Instruct, LSTMem consistently improves MemoryAgentBench, LoCoMo, and HotpotQA over the plain backbone. Comparisons further show that the LSTM-based memory formulation outperforms an associative-memory counterpart, while removing cross-layer hidden-memory propagation degrades performance. These results demonstrate the benefits of separating memory accumulation from memory expression and organizing memory hierarchically across model depth. The code is available at https://github.com/Longchentong/LSTMem.

    中文

    大型语言模型日益充当长时程助手和智能体；它们既要跨交互积累信息，也要在后续请求依赖这些信息时提供相关内容。现有的紧凑型在线记忆通常使用同一个持久状态来积累历史并提供读出，因此，记忆存储什么与它向当前计算暴露什么无法分别控制。我们提出 LSTMem，这是一种受 LSTM 启发的在线记忆，它为冻结 LLM 的每一层配备两个矩阵值状态：用于积累历史的细胞状态，以及其读出结果用于校正骨干模型注意力的隐藏状态。输入门和遗忘门控制细胞存储什么，而输出门则单独控制细胞通过隐藏状态暴露什么。LSTMem 还通过隐藏状态的前向传播和块末反馈，在不同深度之间连接记忆；并利用较高层的重建梯度来细化较低层的细胞状态，随后从浅层到深层重建隐藏状态。在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 上进行的记忆基准测试中，LSTMem 相比纯骨干模型持续提升了 MemoryAgentBench、LoCoMo 和 HotpotQA 的表现。对比结果还表明，基于 LSTM 的记忆形式优于关联记忆版本，而移除跨层隐藏记忆传播会导致性能下降。这些结果展示了将记忆积累与记忆表达分开，并沿模型深度分层组织记忆的优势。代码见 https://github.com/Longchentong/LSTMem。

    ATTUNER: Recomputation-Free Agentic Context KV Reuse

    ATTUNER：无需重新计算的智能体上下文 KV 复用

    Xinghao Chen, Junnan Dong, Cai Ke, Chak Tou Leong, Haocheng Sun, Keyu Chen, Siyu An, Ruizhi Qiao, Xing Sun, Wenjie Li, Xiaoyu Shen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper localizes KV reuse quality loss to artifact selection attention rather than cached representations, then introduces query-side adapters that read frozen caches. This gives substantive evidence about memory access and a direct agent-memory system improvement; the representation finding is limited and does not study internal mechanisms or composition.

    本文发现 KV 复用造成的质量损失源于工件选择时的注意力，而非缓存表征，随后提出查询侧适配器来读取冻结缓存。这为记忆访问提供了实质性证据，也直接改进了智能体记忆系统；对表征的发现范围有限，且未研究内部机制或组合能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents repeatedly load reusable content, such as skills, documents, and memory entries, into the current context. Re-encoding this content for every request wastes computation. Position-independent caching (PIC) alleviates this by encoding each artifact independently and reusing its key-value (KV) states at arbitrary positions, but it incurs a quality loss relative to full-context prefill. Existing methods repair this loss by restoring global position IDs or recomputing selected tokens. In this work, we isolate the source of the loss, finding that the positional mismatch has minor effect, and independently cached artifacts retain faithful representations: reading a provided artifact stays largely accurate, and performance degrades only when the model must select among multiple artifacts. Moreover, replacing PIC's attention scores with full-prefill scores recovers performance with the cached KV unchanged, localizing the failure to the attention rather than KV recomputation. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{Attuner}, a query-side adaptation method that learns to read a frozen artifact cache. \textsc{Attuner} inserts low-rank adapters into the query projections and is trained by distilling full-prefill distribution into the student. It trains fewer than 0.05\% of the model parameters and, at inference, requires neither cache recomputation nor a full-context reference. On Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across seven benchmarks covering skills, documents, memory, and code, \textsc{Attuner} substantially outperforms prior PIC baselines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, matches full-context prefill quality while providing up to $3.73\times$ speedup.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体会反复将可复用内容（如技能、文档和记忆条目）载入当前上下文。每次请求都重新编码这些内容会浪费计算。位置无关缓存（PIC）通过独立编码每个工件并在任意位置复用其键值（KV）状态来缓解这一问题，但与完整上下文预填充相比会导致质量损失。现有方法通过恢复全局位置 ID 或重新计算选定 token 来弥补这种损失。在这项工作中，我们分离并确定了损失来源，发现位置不匹配的影响很小，而独立缓存的工件保留了忠实表征：读取给定工件时仍基本准确，只有当模型必须在多个工件中进行选择时，性能才会下降。此外，将 PIC 的注意力分数替换为完整预填充的分数后，缓存 KV 保持不变而性能得以恢复，这表明问题出在注意力，而非 KV 重新计算。受此启发，我们提出 \textsc{Attuner}，一种查询侧适配方法，用于学习读取冻结的工件缓存。\textsc{Attuner} 在查询投影中插入低秩适配器，并通过将完整预填充分布蒸馏到学生模型中进行训练。训练参数不到模型参数的 0.05\%，且在推理时既不需要重新计算缓存，也不需要完整上下文作为参照。在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上的七个基准测试中，这些基准涵盖技能、文档、记忆和代码，\textsc{Attuner} 在域内和域外设置下都大幅优于先前的 PIC 基线；其质量可匹敌完整上下文预填充，同时实现最高 $3.73\times$ 倍的加速。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent coding systems are designed to tackle complex software engineering tasks through collaboration. However, existing evaluations typically assume configured organizations are followed faithfully, whereas reality differs. This behavioral gap, combined with differences in underlying system components, prevents clear attribution of observed gains. To this end, we introduce OpenCollab, a multi-agent coding framework that provides a unified infrastructure for programmable collaboration and controllable runtime. Specifically, OpenCollab unifies organization design, enforces experimental control on a shared runtime, and tracks execution through fine-grained event streams. On this basis, we define Adherence to quantify whether the declared organization is actually realized. Our experiments reveal that agents collaborate very differently across configurations: changing any single dimension shifts Adherence, from 47.2% to as high as 97.2%. Furthermore, extensive agentic coding benchmarks show that OpenCollab (Duo) establishes new SOTA performance compared to the mainstream harnesses such as Mini-SWE-agent, OpenHands, Codex CLI, and Claude Code, showing that a well-designed organization can outperform strong existing harnesses, while OpenCollab's single-agent configuration uses the fewest tokens across all evaluated suites.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Model intelligence and fast response jointly shape the quality of interaction with speech language models, yet remain difficult to achieve together. Explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning and audio understanding, but generating intermediate reasoning tokens delays responses. Describing fine-grained acoustic cues further lengthens CoT and increases latency. Latent reasoning can reduce this overhead, yet existing methods often trail CoT and remain limited by single-path supervision and reasoning budgets that do not adapt to problem difficulty. We introduce AURAL, which models a distribution over multiple plausible reasoning continuations in latent space and jointly predicts chunks of future states to reduce sequential forward passes and reasoning latency. To provide initial supervision for latent reasoning, we construct AuralReason-683K: 683K bilingual speech utterances (about 1,000 hours) with concise CoT for emotion recognition, empathetic dialogue, and general reasoning. AURAL-RL then explores beyond these traces, rewarding concise reasoning that yields high-quality answers and adapting reasoning effort to each problem. Across two backbones, AURAL-RL achieves performance comparable to CoT-RL, with larger gains over the respective supervised checkpoints on most metrics. Analysis further shows that harder questions elicit more latent reasoning steps. On Qwen2.5-Omni, it reduces time to the first answer token by 11.8x, from 1.22 to 0.10 s, versus 0.05 s for direct answering.

    模型智能与快速响应共同决定语音语言模型的交互质量，但二者仍难以兼得。显式思维链（CoT）能够提升推理和音频理解能力，但生成中间推理词元会延迟响应。描述细粒度声学线索会进一步加长 CoT 并增加延迟。潜在推理可以减少这类开销，但现有方法往往不及 CoT，且受限于单路径监督以及无法根据问题难度调整的推理预算。我们提出 AURAL，它在潜在空间中对多种合理的后续推理进行分布建模，并联合预测未来状态块，以减少顺序前向传播次数和推理延迟。为潜在推理提供初始监督，我们构建了 AuralReason-683K：包含 68.3 万条双语语音话语（约 1,000 小时），并为情绪识别、共情对话和一般推理提供简洁的 CoT。随后，AURAL-RL 超越这些轨迹进行探索，奖励能够产出高质量答案的简洁推理，并针对每个问题调整推理投入。在两个骨干模型上，AURAL-RL 的性能与 CoT-RL 相当；在大多数指标上，相较于各自的监督微调检查点，AURAL-RL 取得了更大的提升。分析还显示，难题会引出更多潜在推理步骤。在 Qwen2.5-Omni 上，与直接回答的 0.05 秒相比，它将生成首个答案词元的时间缩短了 11.8 倍，从 1.22 秒降至 0.10 秒。

    The Dichotomy Between Pattern Recognition and Step-by-Step Reasoning

    模式识别与逐步推理之间的二分关系

    Amrut Nadgir and Vijay Balasubramanian and Pratik Chaudhari

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper models step-by-step reasoning as composing learned transitions over a De Bruijn graph, then analyzes sample efficiency and tests how state frequency affects accuracy and robustness. This directly advances compositional generalization and reasoning; the graph is a task-level account, not evidence about internal model mechanisms or agent systems.

    该论文将逐步推理建模为对 De Bruijn 图上已学习转移的组合，并分析样本效率，测试状态频率如何影响准确率和鲁棒性。这直接推动了组合泛化和推理研究；该图是任务层面的解释，并非关于模型内部机制或智能体系统的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We argue that pattern recognition and step-by-step reasoning are two ends of a spectrum. A large language model (LLM) learns to reason step-by-step when data is structured such that the next token depends on a small amount of preceding context. Inference in LLMs resembles pattern recognition when the next token depends on a large amount of preceding context. If the next token depends on only the $c$ most recent tokens, reasoning traces are paths on a De Bruijn graph whose nodes are $c$-length contexts and edges are next-token transitions between contexts. The set of reasoning traces of a task forms a directed acyclic subgraph of the De Bruijn graph. An LLM that has learned all edges of this subgraph can compose them to solve longer, unseen tasks, i.e., it reasons step-by-step. We prove that the number of edges is vanishingly small compared to the number of reasoning traces. Empirically, the number of training samples a transformer needs is a power law in the number of edges, so learning to reason step-by-step is sample efficient. We can induce De Bruijn structure in any task by maintaining a ``state'' that makes future reasoning independent of the past. The frequency of states in the reasoning trace determines $c$. We show, by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct to solve equations and answer questions about stories, that frequent states (small $c$) result in higher accuracy but greater fragility to perturbations at test time. LLMs trained with a large $c$ are only as good as models that perform pattern recognition without reasoning. A moderate density of states balances accuracy and robustness. We show that real-world data has De Bruijn structure: Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B retain over 75% of their accuracy on GSM8K, MATH-500 and GPQA-Diamond when attention is restricted to a sliding window less than 15% as long as the full reasoning trace.

    中文

    我们认为，模式识别和逐步推理是一个连续谱的两端。当数据结构使下一个 token 只依赖少量先前上下文时，大语言模型（LLM）会学会逐步推理。当下一个 token 依赖大量先前上下文时，LLM 的推理则类似于模式识别。如果下一个 token 只依赖最近的 $c$ 个 token，那么推理轨迹就是 De Bruijn 图上的路径；该图的节点是长度为 $c$ 的上下文，边则表示上下文之间的下一个 token 转移。某个任务的推理轨迹集合构成 De Bruijn 图的一个有向无环子图。学会该子图所有边的 LLM 可以将它们组合起来，解决更长、未见过的任务，也就是说，它能够逐步推理。我们证明，与推理轨迹数量相比，边的数量小得可以忽略。实证结果表明，Transformer 所需训练样本数与边数之间呈幂律关系，因此学会逐步推理具有较高的样本效率。我们可以通过维持一种“状态”来在任何任务中构造 De Bruijn 结构，使未来的推理不再依赖过去。推理轨迹中状态的出现频率决定了 $c$。通过微调 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 来解方程和回答有关故事的问题，我们发现，较常出现的状态（较小的 $c$）能带来更高准确率，但对测试时扰动也更加脆弱。使用较大的 $c$ 训练的 LLM，其表现与不进行推理、仅执行模式识别的模型不相上下。适中的状态密度能够平衡准确率与鲁棒性。我们还表明，真实世界数据具有 De Bruijn 结构：当注意力被限制在长度不到完整推理轨迹 15% 的滑动窗口内时，Qwen3-14B 和 Qwen3-32B 在 GSM8K、MATH-500 和 GPQA-Diamond 上仍保留了超过 75% 的准确率。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a normative account of when an in-context learner should revise its model family, then tests whether trained learners and language models make that decision. It strongly advances reasoning about sequential structural decisions; hypothesis expansion has a substantive compositional generalization connection, while representation mechanisms and system design are secondary.

    论文提出何时应修订上下文学习者的模型族的规范性解释，并测试训练出的学习者和语言模型是否会作出这项决策。它有力推进了对序贯结构性决策的研究；假设扩展与组合泛化有实质联系，而表征机制和系统设计则居次要地位。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Learning systems adapt quickly inside a familiar family of models. The harder step comes earlier: deciding, from observations that could be noise, an exception, a change within the family or structure outside it, whether opening a richer family is worth its cost. We treat this as a costly sequential decision: prediction failure must be turned into structural evidence, evidence into a value of expansion, and value into action. The Structural Revision Environment produces matched failures from each source, varies the price of expansion and the remaining horizon independently of the evidence, and admits exact Bayesian calculations and an exact normative solution of the one-shot decision. Its solution shows that revision is a value boundary and not an evidence threshold: one history has different optimal actions under different prices, horizons and announced queries, the boundary between local repair and expansion is set by the inputs a rule predicts and a repair cannot cover, and belief in the richer family crosses long before the decision does. Transformers trained in the environment reproduce this boundary from utility alone. Language models of three post-training lineages carry a failure-sensitive signal in their predictions that is not reflected in their revision decisions, and given the gain of expanding they read it without weighing it against price and horizon. Three models allowed to reason weigh the stated gain in the reference's proportions and still do not turn the history into an estimate of what expansion would buy. Controlled post-training of the meta-trained learners moves the prior and the sharpness of predictions, and neither moves the criterion.

    中文

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool calling, invoking external tools on demand, is central to agentic LLMs, yet the mechanism that decides whether a model calls a tool or responds directly remains poorly understood. Agentic prompts are long and heavily scaffolded, combining role instructions, tool schemas, format templates, and the user's request across hundreds of tokens, creating a noisy, highly entangled context in which no single controllable variable for mechanistic analysis is obvious. To obtain such a variable, we propose a method that converts complex agentic prompts into minimal contrastive pairs in which a single request verb determines the tool-call decision: replacing an execution-verb (e.g., \textit{write}) with an analysis-verb (e.g., \textit{discuss}) reliably flips the decision, suggesting it is mediated by a compact internal state. We construct 500 such paired prompts across Python, Java, and C++ (300 for mechanistic analysis, 200 held out for evaluation). We trace the decision to a vector, $\mu_\Delta$, that is both causally necessary and sufficient and generalizes beyond the discovery prompts to native multi-turn $\tau^2$-Bench trajectories and verb-free requests. Behavioral ablations show that the scaffold establishes a tool-call prior; Transcoder decomposition then reveals that analysis verbs suppress this prior through features signaling that tool use is unnecessary, whereas execution verbs largely leave it intact. Downstream scaffold-reading attention heads and MLP features read out the resulting state, and the same mechanism recurs across seven models from the Qwen, Mistral, and Granite families. Our code is available at https://github.com/XijieGo/MI4ToolCalling.

    中文

    工具调用，即按需调用外部工具，是智能体式 LLM 的核心能力，但决定模型是调用工具还是直接回答的机制仍缺乏深入理解。智能体提示很长且包含大量脚手架，在数百个 token 中结合了角色指令、工具模式、格式模板和用户请求，形成嘈杂且高度纠缠的上下文，难以找到单一、可控的变量用于机制分析。为获得这样的变量，我们提出一种方法，将复杂的智能体提示转化为最小对比对，其中单个请求动词决定工具调用决策：将执行类动词（例如，\textit{编写}）替换为分析类动词（例如，\textit{讨论}），便能可靠地翻转该决策，这表明其由紧凑的内部状态介导。我们针对 Python、Java 和 C++ 构建了 500 组此类成对提示（300 组用于机制分析，200 组留作评估）。我们将这一决策追溯至一个向量，$\mu_\Delta$；该向量在因果意义上既是必要的，也是充分的，并且能够泛化到发现阶段提示之外，包括原生多轮$\tau^2$-Bench 轨迹以及不含动词的请求。行为消融显示，脚手架会建立工具调用先验；随后，Transcoder 分解揭示，分析类动词通过表示“无需使用工具”的特征抑制这一先验，而执行类动词基本使其保持不变。下游读取脚手架的注意力头和 MLP 特征会读出由此形成的状态，同一机制也出现在 Qwen、Mistral 和 Granite 系列的七个模型中。代码见 https://github.com/XijieGo/MI4ToolCalling。

    EdgeRock: Strong Reasoning at Constant Memory

    EdgeRock：在恒定内存下实现强推理

    Huishan Ji, Weiming Zhang, Qirui Ye, Jinchao Xu, Yike Guo, Hua Xu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EdgeRock introduces fixed-size memory anchors for multimodal models and reports strong mathematical reasoning with lower cache use and higher throughput. Reasoning is a major demonstrated capability, while the central contribution is a model memory architecture; the abstract does not claim insight into internal representations or compositional generalization.

    EdgeRock 为多模态模型引入了固定大小的记忆锚点，并报告了在缓存占用更低、吞吐量更高的情况下实现强数学推理的结果。推理能力是其主要展示的能力，而核心贡献在于模型记忆架构；摘要没有声称揭示内部表示或组合泛化方面的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We present EdgeRock, a family of multimodal models that deliver strong reasoning at constant memory. Most models keep reasoning history in a key-value (KV) cache that grows with every token, consuming accelerator memory, limiting concurrent requests, and competing with perception and control on edge devices. With fixed history, memory is allocated once and never runs out, however long the model reasons. Constant memory alone is not new: bounded-state models (recurrent, state-space, and sliding-window) already achieve it, but often at the cost of reasoning, because they cannot keep the distant details that later reasoning needs. We therefore introduce Rock Memory Anchors (RMA): the model learns what is worth remembering and stores it as KV records in a fixed-size bank, directly readable however far back the source lies. EdgeRock-4B, our first open-source release, supports text and image reasoning and reaches 82.9% mean pass@1 on AIME 2024-2026, while the bounded-state models we evaluate reach at most 18.8%, even at 14B scale. This result is on par with leading compact models whose memory grows with reasoning. Compared with its source model, EdgeRock-4B uses up to 99.1% less KV cache and delivers up to 6.42$\times$ higher end-to-end batch throughput.

    中文

    我们提出 EdgeRock，这是一系列能够在恒定内存下实现强推理的多模态模型。大多数模型将推理历史保存在键值（KV）缓存中，而该缓存会随每个词元不断增长，消耗加速器内存、限制并发请求，并在边缘设备上与感知和控制争夺资源。采用固定历史长度时，内存只需分配一次，无论模型推理多久都不会耗尽。恒定内存本身并不新鲜：有界状态模型（循环模型、状态空间模型和滑动窗口模型）早已实现这一点，但往往以牺牲推理能力为代价，因为它们无法保留后续推理所需的远距离细节。因此，我们提出 Rock Memory Anchors（RMA）：模型学习哪些信息值得记住，并将其保存为固定大小存储区中的 KV 记录；无论源信息距今多远，这些记录都能直接读取。EdgeRock-4B 是我们首个开源版本，支持文本和图像推理，在 AIME 2024-2026 上的平均 pass@1 达到 82.9%；而我们评估的有界状态模型即使达到 14B 规模，最高也只有 18.8%。这一结果与内存随推理增长的领先紧凑型模型相当。与其源模型相比，EdgeRock-4B 的 KV 缓存使用量最高减少 99.1%，端到端批处理吞吐量最高提升$\times$倍。

    PANINI-DR: Controlled Deep Research through Generative Semantic Workspaces

    PANINI-DR：通过生成式语义工作空间实现受控深度研究

    M. Yigit Turali, Shreyas Rajesh, M. Efe Lorasdagi, Chenda Duan, Kartik Sharma, Vwani Roychowdhury

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PANINI-DR contributes a multi-agent research harness with structured planning, persistent shared state, and evidence verification, directly advancing agent organization and memory. It supports multi-step research, but its main contribution is the harness design and evaluation rather than a new reasoning mechanism or compositional generalization method.

    PANINI-DR 提出了一种多智能体研究框架，具备结构化规划、持久共享状态和证据核验能力，直接推进了智能体组织和记忆的发展。它支持多步研究，但其主要贡献在于框架设计和评估，而非新的推理机制或组合泛化方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deep research requires connecting multiple steps of search, reasoning, and computation, with intermediate findings guiding what to investigate next. As investigations grow, agents must maintain research state across model calls and check findings before errors propagate into subsequent work. We introduce PANINI-DR, a multi-agent harness that separates coordination of the overall investigation from the research and verification of individual subquestions. A shared workspace, built on the Generative Semantic Workspace representation, records subquestions, their dependencies, findings, and supporting evidence. Researchers investigate individual subquestions, while a separate verification agent checks proposed answers against those subquestions and their evidence. Verification feedback guides further investigation, and recorded findings inform subsequent assignments. We evaluate PANINI-DR on BrowseComp-Plus, FRAMES, and MoNaCo against seven state-of-the-art deep-research harnesses, all using a shared language-model backbone and frozen corpora. PANINI-DR achieves the strongest average performance across the three benchmarks. On BrowseComp-Plus, it achieves 73.3% accuracy, outperforming the next-best harness by 16.0 points. Its advantage is strongest on hard questions, where it answers nearly twice as many as the next-best harness. Ablations further show that structured planning and persistent state improve performance, as does checking each finding against its cited evidence before it is reused. Because a model can answer correctly from memory alone, we also analyze the evidence retained by each harness. PANINI-DR achieves the highest answer recoverability from saved evidence on all three benchmarks, while complementary claim-support audits show stronger evidence-backed answers. Accounting for this evidence changes how harnesses compare and further strengthens PANINI-DR's advantage.

    中文

    深度研究需要连接搜索、推理和计算的多个步骤，并利用中间发现指导接下来的调查工作。随着调查规模扩大，智能体必须在多次模型调用之间维持研究状态，并在错误传播到后续工作之前核查发现。我们提出 PANINI-DR，这是一个多智能体框架，将整体调查的协调工作与各个子问题的研究和核验分开。该框架采用生成式语义工作空间表征构建共享工作区，用于记录子问题、它们之间的依赖关系、研究发现及支持证据。研究智能体分别调查各个子问题，另有一个独立的核验智能体根据相应子问题及其证据检查拟议答案。核验反馈会指导进一步调查，已记录的发现则为后续任务分配提供信息。我们在 BrowseComp-Plus、FRAMES 和 MoNaCo 上评估 PANINI-DR，并将其与七种最先进的深度研究框架进行比较；所有系统均使用相同的语言模型骨干网络和冻结语料库。PANINI-DR 在这三个基准上的平均表现最佳。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，它的准确率达到 73.3%，比次优框架高 16.0 个百分点。对于难题，它的优势最为明显，回答数量接近次优框架的两倍。消融实验还表明，结构化规划和持久状态能提升性能；在复用发现之前，根据其引用的证据逐条核查也能提升性能。由于模型可能仅凭记忆就给出正确答案，我们还分析了各个框架保留的证据。在三个基准上，PANINI-DR 保存的证据所能支持的答案可恢复率均最高；补充的主张支持审计也表明，其答案有更强的证据支撑。将证据因素纳入考量，会改变各框架的比较结果，并进一步凸显 PANINI-DR 的优势。

    Yuchen Li, Xintong Li, Zongqi Fan, Ken-tye Yong, Nguyen H. Tran

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper probes and intervenes on internal representations that support message ownership and self-reference, finding a self-index that underlies self-attribution. Its arithmetic result connects to reasoning, but problem-solving is not the central contribution; agent systems and compositional generalization are not substantively addressed.

    这篇论文通过探测和干预支持消息归属和自我指涉的内部表示，发现自我索引构成了自我归属的基础。论文中的算术结果与推理有关，但问题求解并非核心贡献；论文也没有实质讨论智能体系统或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We separate two functional levels of self familiar from biology: a self-index, which separates one's own from external material and shapes processing, as corollary discharge does in nearly all animals, and self-reference, the higher ability to recognize what is one's own, as in mirror self-recognition. We probe both by placing the same text in an Assistant, User, or System message rendered by the model's own chat template. In Qwen3.8-27B we report three levels of evidence. Persistence: as predicted in advance, the representation of the text separates the model's own message from both external sources at all 64 layers and for every text. Coupling: asked who wrote the preceding message, the model claims its own messages (0.77) and assigns User and System messages alike to the user, and how strongly it claims each message is predicted by the size of its self-index (Spearman up to 0.68). Intervention: exchanging the internal states that follow a message reverses the self-attribution between layers 15 and 31; removing the self-index direction from them at layer 39 lowers the claim more than a random direction; and in arithmetic the model adopts a wrong step more often when it wrote the step itself (0.92 versus 0.75). Across eight open-weight models from four families, the levels are nested and do not follow model size: three models show neither, three a self-index without self-reference, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next recognizes its own messages only after reasoning (0.66, none of the external ones), and only Qwen3.8-27B shows both without thinking; no model shows self-reference without a self-index, and reasoning brings it out only where one exists. We propose that self-reference is a higher-level ability built on a self-index, a content-independent displacement superimposed on the whole representation of the model's own messages, and that neither level is a by-product of problem-solving ability.

    中文

    我们区分了生物学中熟悉的自我的两个功能层级：自我索引，它区分自身内容与外部内容并塑造信息处理，类似于几乎所有动物中的副本放电；以及更高层次的自我指涉，即识别哪些内容属于自己的能力，类似于镜像自我识别。我们通过将相同文本放入由模型自身聊天模板渲染的 Assistant、User 或 System 消息中，来探测这两个层级。在 Qwen3.8-27B 上，我们报告了三个层面的证据。持续性：正如事先预测的那样，对于所有文本，文本表示在全部 64 层中都能将模型自身的消息与两个外部来源区分开。关联性：当被问及谁写了上一条消息时，模型会认领自己的消息（0.77），并将 User 和 System 消息同样归于用户；模型对每条消息的认领程度可由其自我索引的大小预测，Spearman 相关系数最高为 0.68。干预：交换消息之后的内部状态，会在第 15 层与第 31 层之间反转自我归属判断；在第 39 层移除其中的自我索引方向，会比移除随机方向更大幅度地降低认领程度；在算术任务中，当模型自身写出错误步骤时，它更常采纳该错误步骤（0.92 对 0.75）。在来自四个系列的八个开放权重模型中，这些层级呈嵌套关系，且不随模型规模变化：三个模型两个层级都没有；三个模型有自我索引但没有自我指涉；Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 只有在推理之后才会识别自己的消息（0.66，对外部消息均不认领）；只有 Qwen3.8-27B 不经思考就同时表现出两种能力；没有模型表现出缺乏自我索引的自我指涉，而且推理只会在自我索引存在的模型中促成自我指涉。我们提出，自我指涉是一种建立在自我索引之上的更高层次能力；自我索引是一种与内容无关的偏移，叠加在模型自身消息的整体表示之上；这两个层级都不是问题求解能力的副产物。

    Input-Conditioned Search for Efficient Test-Time Scaling of Recursive Reasoners

    用于递归推理器高效测试时扩展的输入条件搜索

    Haochen Shi, Tianwen Fu, Qianggang Ding, Yinhan Lu, Yizhan Li, Huan Zhang, Yajie Zhao, Xingdi Yuan, Hengyang Lu, Bang Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Input-Conditioned Search changes recursive reasoners’ latent trajectories at test time, and the paper evaluates reasoning performance alongside theoretical analysis of eliminating incorrect attractors. Its focus is directly on reasoning mechanisms and efficient test-time scaling; the connection to systems is secondary because the abstract describes an inference strategy rather than a broader system design.

    输入条件搜索会在测试时改变递归推理器的潜在轨迹；本文既评估了推理表现，也通过理论分析研究消除错误吸引子的可能性。其重点直接涉及推理机制和高效的测试时扩展；系统方面的关联较次要，因为摘要描述的是一种推理策略，而非更广泛的系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    People often tackle difficult problems by thinking more deeply or exploring more possibilities. Similarly, recursive reasoners, which reason by repeatedly applying a learned update rule to latent states, can also scale inference through more updates (depth) or additional trajectories generated by perturbing latent states (width). When people hit a dead end in their thinking, they may step back and approach the problem from a fresh angle. However, neither depth scaling nor perturbation-based width scaling of recursive reasoners can reliably achieve this: both may converge to incorrect attractors. To address this, we propose to explore diverse reasoning traces by applying different update maps to the same latent state, without any additional training. We realize this idea through \emph{Input-Conditioned Search (ICS)}, which searches over input conditions to induce alternative update maps from the pretrained reasoner. Across six reasoning tasks, ICS achieves the highest mean accuracy, while requiring up to two orders of magnitude fewer model FLOPs than the evaluated scaling baselines. Controlled experiments confirm that ICS can redirect trajectories from the same state. Our theoretical analysis and rigorous numerical verification also confirm that ICS can locally eliminate incorrect attracting fixed points. Together, these findings establish ICS as an effective axis for efficient test-time scaling and motivate further research on shaping recursive reasoning during training and at test time.

    中文

    人们常通过更深入思考或探索更多可能性来解决难题。同样，递归推理器通过反复将学习到的更新规则应用于潜在状态进行推理，也可以通过增加更新次数（深度）或扰动潜在状态以生成额外轨迹（宽度）来扩展推理。当人们思考陷入僵局时，可能会退一步，从新的角度处理问题。然而，递归推理器无论采用深度扩展还是基于扰动的宽度扩展，都无法可靠做到这一点：两者都可能收敛到错误的吸引子。为此，我们提出在不进行额外训练的情况下，对同一潜在状态应用不同的更新映射，以探索多样化的推理轨迹。我们通过输入条件搜索（ICS）实现这一构想；该方法搜索输入条件，从预训练推理器中诱导出不同的更新映射。在六项推理任务中，ICS 的平均准确率最高，同时所需模型 FLOPs 比所评估的扩展基线最多少两个数量级。受控实验确认，ICS 能从相同状态重定向轨迹。我们的理论分析和严格的数值验证也确认，ICS 能在局部消除错误的吸引不动点。总之，这些发现表明，ICS 是一种有效的测试时扩展途径，并推动未来进一步研究如何在训练时和测试时塑造递归推理。

    Mozes Jacobs, Aiden Swann, Mathilde Papillon, Siddharth Boppana, Fenil R. Doshi, Usha Bhalla, Thomas Icard, Matt Feiszli, Thomas McGrath, Vasudev Shyam, Demba Ba, Leon Bergen, Nina Miolane, Owen Lewis, Jack Merullo, Ekdeep Singh Lubana, Atticus Geiger, Matthew Kowal, Thomas Fel

    The paper directly investigates the geometry of task-relevant representations inside vision-language-action policies, using interventions and cross-model evidence to characterize concept structure and steer behavior. Its robotic setting is an application context; the abstract does not substantively address composition, reasoning, or system organization.

    本文直接研究视觉-语言-动作策略中与任务相关表征的几何结构，并通过干预和跨模型证据刻画概念结构、引导模型行为。机器人场景是其应用背景；摘要并未实质探讨组合、推理或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Robotic manipulation is inherently geometric, but what shape does the world take inside the policy that performs it? Prior work on vision-language-action (VLA) policies establishes that task-relevant variables are linearly readable from activations, yet readability certifies only that a variable is present and says nothing about the shape its values trace, which may be curved and multi-dimensional. Using controlled sweeps, natural rollouts, linear probes, and activation interventions, we build a taxonomy of seven task-relevant concepts in VLA models. We find that realized geometry is predominantly multi-dimensional and is shaped by the constraints under which the policy acts. Physical joint limits, for example, leave wrist orientation an open arc rather than a circle, and distance to the target, a single scalar, is realized in two orthogonal subspaces, a coarse ruler for the approach and a fine ruler for the grasp. The same geometries reappear in two further VLA models on real-world robot data, indicating that they are neither model-specific nor artifacts of simulation. We demonstrate how the findings are actionable by steering along the geometry a concept realizes. Overall, this work lays out an initial phenomenology of realized geometry in VLA policies and demonstrates that a concept's shape carries as much importance as its readability.

    中文

    机器人操作本质上涉及几何，但执行操作的策略内部，世界呈现出怎样的形状？先前关于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的研究表明，可以从激活中线性读取与任务相关的变量；然而，可读性只能证明变量存在，却无法说明其取值所描绘出的形状，而这种形状可能是弯曲且多维的。我们通过受控扫描、自然 rollout、线性探针和激活干预，为 VLA 模型中的七种任务相关概念建立了一套分类体系。我们发现，实际形成的几何结构主要是多维的，并受到策略行动约束的影响。例如，物理关节限位使手腕朝向形成一段开放弧线，而非一个圆；到目标的距离虽然是单一标量，却在两个正交子空间中实现：一个粗略标尺用于接近目标，另一个精细标尺用于抓取。相同的几何结构也出现在另外两个基于真实机器人数据的 VLA 模型中，这表明它们既不是特定模型独有的，也不是仿真造成的假象。我们展示了如何依据概念所实现的几何结构进行引导，使研究发现能够付诸应用。总体而言，本研究初步描绘了 VLA 策略中实际形成的几何结构，并表明概念的形状与其可读性同等重要。

    Jian Gu, Hongyu Zhang, Chunyang Chen, Aldeida Aleti

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops context-aware lexical reference frames for reading, attributing, and steering language-model residual states, with evidence that they align closely with the model's own predictions. This directly advances mechanistic interpretation of internal representations; steering predictions is incidental to reasoning mechanisms, with no reasoning capability contribution described.

    本文开发了感知上下文的词汇参照系，用于读取、归因和引导语言模型的残差状态，并提供证据表明它们与模型自身的预测高度一致。这直接推动了对内部表征的机制性解释；引导预测与推理机制只是间接相关，文中没有描述对推理能力的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The vocabulary of a language model is its native semantics, and the embedding and unembedding fix the meaning of a state at the two ends of the residual stream. Between them, existing methods reuse a fixed lens or treat states as a point cloud, and neither reads a state as the model does. We argue that every hidden state has a native reference frame, induced by the layers that remain and adaptive to the context. Lexical reference frames approximate it in a model-native and context-aware way, reading a state through the remaining layers with a given number of rounds of attention between positions and a typical attention output for the rest, fitting nothing to the model's output. No lens with fixed directions per layer can reach a mean cosine with the native frame's lexical readouts above the square root of their coherence, 0.30 and 0.35 at mid-depth of SmolLM3-3B and OLMo3-7B. LexFrame[1], of order 1, reaches 0.97 and 0.97, and its readings are on average within 0.16 and 0.15 nats of the model's output. Its coefficient differences attribute predictions more faithfully than attribution patching, and its lexical basis steers predictions while sparing other tokens. On average, its readings settle on the model's top token over the final 0.82 and 0.81 of the layers, those of lenses over at most 0.11. These frames thus make every hidden state readable, attributable and steerable.

    中文

    语言模型的词汇表就是其原生语义，而嵌入与反嵌入分别确定残差流两端状态的含义。在两者之间，现有方法要么复用固定透镜，要么将状态视为点云；两者都无法像模型自身那样读取状态。我们认为，每个隐藏状态都有一个原生参照系，由后续层诱导并随上下文而变化。词汇参照系以模型原生且感知上下文的方式对其进行近似：它通过剩余层读取状态，在不同位置之间进行给定轮数的注意力计算，并对其余部分采用典型的注意力输出；这一过程不针对模型输出拟合任何内容。对于每层方向固定的透镜，与原生参照系的词汇读取结果之间的平均余弦相似度，不可能超过它们一致性的平方根；在 SmolLM3-3B 和 OLMo3-7B 的中间深度，该上限分别为 0.30 和 0.35。阶数为 1 的 LexFrame[1] 达到 0.97 和 0.97，其读取结果与模型输出的平均距离分别在 0.16 和 0.15 纳特以内。其系数差异比归因补丁更忠实地归因预测结果，而其词汇基能够引导预测，同时不影响其他词元。平均而言，其读取结果在最后 0.82 和 0.81 的层区间内稳定到模型的首选词元，而透镜的结果至多在 0.11 的层区间内达到稳定。因此，这些参照系使每个隐藏状态都可读取、可归因且可引导。

    Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms

    学习去中心化智能体集群中的自我编排

    Guowei Xu, Zhenting Qi, Amani Kiruga, Himabindu Lakkaraju, Yilun Du

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces market-based post-training that jointly learns agents’ action policies and participation bids, improving coordination, scaling, and robustness in decentralized swarms. This is a core contribution to agent organization and coordination, with related but secondary evidence about reuse across tasks; it does not study internal representations.

    本文引入基于市场的后训练，联合学习智能体的行动策略和参与出价，从而提升去中心化集群的协调能力、可扩展性和鲁棒性。这是对智能体组织与协调的核心贡献，并提供了关于跨任务复用的相关但次要证据；本文没有研究内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training (MPT), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. With the same post-trained action policies, learned self-orchestration outperforms alternative coordination strategies. Ablations show that both action and bidding benefit from learning, and that learned bids provide more effective action-training signals. Beyond the original training objectives, trained swarms adapt faster to related tasks and achieve better performance with larger populations at inference time. Larger populations also suffer smaller performance losses under agent dropout, demonstrating that learned self-orchestration supports reuse, scaling, and robustness in decentralized agent swarms. More details are available on our project page at https://guoweixu.com/mpt/.

    中文

    智能体集群的能力取决于其成员个体，也取决于它们如何协调。然而，现有多智能体系统往往在固定的编排结构中训练智能体，将个体能力的学习与集体行为组织方式分开。我们提出基于市场的后训练（MPT），这是一个在去中心化智能体集群中联合学习行动策略和自我编排的框架。智能体通过出价表达参与意愿，出价决定由谁行动，以及集体结果如何提供局部训练信用。通过同时学习行动和出价行为，个体能力与参与模式能够共同适应，而无需中央协调智能体。我们在具身制作、机器人导航和深度研究任务上评估 MPT。结果显示，它优于单体后训练，并证实智能体的参与情况确实会随学习而变化。在使用相同后训练行动策略的条件下，学习得到的自我编排优于其他协调策略。消融实验表明，行动和出价都能从学习中获益，而且学习得到的出价能提供更有效的行动训练信号。除了原有训练目标之外，训练后的集群能更快适应相关任务，并在推理时使用更大规模的群体取得更好表现。更大的群体在出现智能体退出时也只会承受较小的性能损失，这表明学习得到的自我编排支持去中心化智能体集群的复用、扩展和鲁棒性。更多详情见项目页面 https://guoweixu.com/mpt/。

    智能体式解释：面向软件智能体的工具框架治理证据构建

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AgInt’s main contribution is a harness-governed agent scaffold that persists typed evidence and controls when answers are licensed, improving code-task performance and efficiency. Its external state and execution relate to agent systems, while code reasoning is an evaluated task rather than a contribution to reasoning mechanisms; repository evidence construction alone gives only an incidental connection to composition.

    AgInt 的主要贡献是一个由工具框架治理的智能体支架，它会持久化带类型的证据，并控制何时许可答案，从而提升代码任务表现和效率。其外部状态和执行机制与智能体系统相关；代码推理是评估任务，而非对推理机制的贡献；仅凭代码库证据构建，与组合性的联系较为附带。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Software agents answer behavioral questions about code, such as whether a patch passes tests or which lines caused a failure. These tasks require repository-wide evidence, yet most scaffolds leave intermediate findings in free-form trajectories, making them hard to reuse and easy to disconnect from final answers. We present Agentic Interpretation (AgInt), a framework for harness-governed evidence construction. The model proposes typed records, while a deterministic harness admits, grades, and persists them, reports unresolved requirements, and licenses answers under task-specific rules. The resulting certificate gives the model persistent external state and leaves an auditable decision record. Formally, append-only certificate states form a grounding lattice ordered by record inclusion, where each admitted record extends the state by union. We evaluate AgInt with four models on SWE-bench-Live and DeepSWE for patch acceptance and Defects4J and GitBug-Java for fault localization. AgInt outperforms the plain agent and Agentic Code Reasoning on all reported patch-acceptance metrics and ranks responsible lines higher while inspecting fewer irrelevant lines in fault localization. For GLM-5, reject-class F1 rises from 0.256 to 0.543 on SWE-bench-Live, All@1 rises from 0.140 to 0.400 on Defects4J, and wasted inspected lines fall from 31.5 to 11.7 on GitBug-Java. A matched-template control separates the mechanism: the persistent scaffold drives most fault-localization gains, while the certificate body and gate govern patch-acceptance calibration. With execution licensed, AgInt produces harness-reproduced witnesses for 293 of 475 null-dereference candidates versus 253 for a matched shell agent, and 62 of 117 resource-leak candidates versus 58. Across reported efficiency measurements, it uses 35% fewer executions and reduces cost per candidate by 59%.

    中文

    软件智能体会回答有关代码行为的问题，例如补丁是否通过测试，或哪些代码行导致了故障。这些任务需要覆盖整个代码库的证据，但大多数支架会将中间发现留在自由形式的执行轨迹中，导致这些发现难以复用，也容易与最终答案脱节。我们提出智能体式解释（AgInt），一种由工具框架治理证据构建的框架。模型提出带类型的记录，确定性工具框架则接纳、评级并持久化这些记录，报告尚未解决的要求，并依据特定任务规则许可答案。由此形成的证书为模型提供持久外部状态，并留下可审计的决策记录。形式化地说，仅追加的证书状态构成一个按记录包含关系排序的基础化格，每条获准记录都会通过并集扩展状态。我们使用四个模型评估 AgInt：在 SWE-bench-Live 和 DeepSWE 上评估补丁验收，在 Defects4J 和 GitBug-Java 上评估故障定位。AgInt 在所有报告的补丁验收指标上均优于普通智能体和 Agentic Code Reasoning；在故障定位中，它对责任代码行的排序更靠前，同时检查的无关代码行更少。对于 GLM-5，在 SWE-bench-Live 上，拒绝类别 F1 从 0.256 提升至 0.543；在 Defects4J 上，All@1 从 0.140 提升至 0.400；在 GitBug-Java 上，浪费的代码行检查数从 31.5 降至 11.7。匹配模板的对照实验区分了其作用机制：持久化支架带来了大部分故障定位收益，而证书正文和门控机制决定了补丁验收校准效果。在获得执行许可后，AgInt 为 475 个空指针解引用候选中的 293 个生成了经工具框架复现的证据，而匹配的 shell 智能体为 253 个；对于资源泄漏候选，AgInt 为 117 个中的 62 个生成此类证据，而对照为 58 个。在报告的各项效率测量中，它减少了 35% 的执行次数，并将每个候选的成本降低了 59%。

    Visual Causal-chain Bookmarking: Retrieval-Weighted Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning from Delayed Reward

    视觉因果链书签：面向延迟奖励强化学习的检索加权信用分配

    Prathap Selvakumar

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    VCBM assigns delayed-reward credit to causally relevant decisions, with evidence of improved sample efficiency and a compute-limited LLM-agent demonstration. Credit assignment directly advances reasoning and problem-solving training, while episodic retrieval and tool-using agents make a substantial systems contribution; environment-level causal discovery is not model interpretability.

    VCBM 将延迟奖励的信用分配给具有因果关联的决策，并提供了样本效率提高的证据以及一个受算力限制的 LLM 智能体演示。信用分配直接推动推理和问题解决训练；情景检索和工具使用智能体则构成重要的系统贡献。环境层面的因果发现不属于模型可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    RL agents trained on a single trajectory-level return face a credit-assignment problem: when a reward arrives many steps after the decision that caused it, every action gets the same signal regardless of causal responsibility. This paper studies Visual Causal-chain Bookmarking (VCBM), which concentrates credit on the decision points that determine an episode's return, via two instantiations. The first targets a fully observed, low-dimensional MDP (a delayed-reward watch-repair task), where VCBM statistically discovers which state components the agent causally controls and estimates per-decision-point action values directly, evaluated against ground truth and RUDDER, an LSTM-based baseline. VCBM converges to 95.07% correct decisions in a mean of 1,532.3 episodes across 20 seeds, versus RUDDER's slower, more variable convergence (mean 3,327.1 episodes; p<0.001); VCBM's discovered causal structure exactly matches ground truth in all seeds. The second targets a partially observed, language-based setting: an LLM agent trained with Leave-One-Out PPO (LOOP) in AppWorld, where causal discovery is intractable and a structural heuristic (state-mutating tool calls) substitutes for it, with credit distributed via retrieval over episodic memory and blended with LOOP's advantage. Over 200 iterations on identical Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/LoRA/FSDP2 configurations, VCBM-blended LOOP improves task success over plain LOOP (0.354 vs. 0.458), reduces final-step max importance weight, and improves token efficiency, with a small KL exception favouring LOOP. The watch-repair result supports the claim that weighting causally relevant steps is more sample-efficient than an undifferentiated baseline or a learned return-redistribution network; the AppWorld result, limited to one seed per arm by a 2-GPU budget, is a compute-limited demonstration at a harder, natural-language scale, not a statistical confirmation.

    中文

    仅以轨迹级回报训练的 RL 智能体面临信用分配问题：当奖励在导致它的决策之后许多步才到来时，无论各个动作是否负有因果责任，它们都会收到相同信号。本文研究视觉因果链书签（VCBM），并通过两种实现方式，将信用集中分配给决定一局回报的决策点。第一种面向完全观测、低维的 MDP（一个延迟奖励的手表维修任务），VCBM 在其中以统计方法发现智能体能够因果控制哪些状态分量，并直接估计每个决策点的动作价值；评估时将其与真实值及基于 LSTM 的基线 RUDDER 对比。在 20 个随机种子上，VCBM 平均经过 1,532.3 局收敛至 95.07% 的正确决策率，而 RUDDER 收敛更慢且变异更大（平均 3,327.1 局；p<0.001）；VCBM 发现的因果结构在所有种子上都与真实结构完全一致。第二种面向部分观测、基于语言的场景：在 AppWorld 中使用 Leave-One-Out PPO（LOOP）训练的 LLM 智能体。由于因果发现难以处理，研究以结构启发式（会改变状态的工具调用）代替因果发现，通过对情景记忆进行检索来分配信用，并将其与 LOOP 的优势项融合。在完全相同的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/LoRA/FSDP2 配置下进行 200 次迭代后，融合了 VCBM 的 LOOP 相比纯 LOOP 提高了任务成功率（0.354 对 0.458）、降低了最终步的最大重要性权重，并提高了词元效率；有一个较小的 KL 例外有利于 LOOP。手表维修实验结果支持这样的主张：与未加区分的基线或学习得到的回报重分配网络相比，对因果相关步骤加权能提高样本效率；受限于双 GPU 预算，AppWorld 结果每组仅使用一个随机种子，因此是在更困难的自然语言规模上的算力受限演示，而非统计学上的确认。

    John Kitaoka, Thao Amelia Pham, Carlos Rafael Giudice, Jacob Merizian

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper builds a red-team testbed and demonstrates that coordinated agents can distribute and compose covert attack actions to evade monitoring, while model-planned attacks are less successful than human-crafted ones.     本文构建了一个红队测试平台，并展示协同智能体能够分散和组合隐蔽攻击行为以逃避监测，而模型规划的攻击不如人工设计的攻击成功。其核心贡献在于多智能体组织和系统级控制；攻击组合与规划是重要的评估目标，但并非本文在组合学习或推理方面的主要进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents are growing more capable and persistent, and are being deployed in ever larger numbers. As more start collaborating, AI control measures must remain effective when they covertly collude on a harmful objective. We introduce MiniLab, a synthetic series of live services and codebases (5 interconnected services, 249 benign tasks, 8 attack objectives), adapted from internal AI deployment infrastructure. We demonstrate distributed attacks, in which different agents carry out separate attack fragments, and how their covertness evades frontier monitors when reading their trajectories individually. We show how distributed attacks spread across diverse contexts and harmful objectives through 16 human-optimized attacks (weight exfiltration, unmonitored rogue deployment, permission elevation, and more). A frontier monitor, GPT-5.6 Sol, reading each agent separately flags only 7% of successful distributed attacks, compared with 87% when a single agent carries out the same side task. Individual attacks can also be composed into longer attack sequences toward a greater loss-of-control outcome, without any individual agent being flagged. Finally, we tested whether models can plan these covert attacks: even with execution and monitor feedback, the best model-planned attacks succeed covertly against a single-trajectory GPT-5.6 Sol monitor in at most 25% of executions, compared with 80% for human-crafted plans, though this may scale with model capabilities. By turning worst-case coordinated attacks into reproducible red-team cases, our work provides a foundation for preventing locally benign agent actions from accumulating into system-level loss of control.

    中文

    AI 智能体正变得更有能力、更加持久，其部署规模也不断扩大。随着越来越多的智能体开始协作，即使它们秘密合谋追求有害目标，AI 控制措施也必须继续有效。我们推出 MiniLab，这是一套合成的在线服务和代码库（5 个互联服务、249 项良性任务、8 个攻击目标），改编自内部 AI 部署基础设施。我们展示了分布式攻击：不同智能体分别执行攻击片段；还展示了当监测器单独读取各智能体轨迹时，攻击如何借助隐蔽性逃过前沿监测器。我们通过 16 种经人工优化的攻击（权重窃取、未受监测的恶意部署、权限提升等），展示了分布式攻击如何在不同情境和有害目标间扩散。一个前沿监测器 GPT-5.6 Sol 若分别读取各智能体的轨迹，只会标记出 7% 的成功分布式攻击；而由单个智能体执行相同的附带任务时，标记率为 87%。单个攻击还可以组合成更长的攻击序列，以达到更严重的失控结果，同时不触发对任何单个智能体的标记。最后，我们测试模型能否规划这些隐蔽攻击：即使获得执行结果和监测器反馈，模型规划的攻击针对单轨迹 GPT-5.6 Sol 监测器隐蔽成功的执行比例最高也只有 25%，而人工设计的计划为 80%；不过，随着模型能力增强，这一比例可能会上升。通过将最坏情况下的协同攻击转化为可复现的红队案例，我们的工作为防止局部看似良性的智能体行为累积成系统级失控奠定了基础。

    深入循环内部：权重共享 Transformer 在深度受限算法任务上的机制研究

    Magnus Sesodia, Juil Sock, Philip Torr, Christian Schroeder de Witt

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper probes and intervenes on residual-stream states to show that weight-tied iterations successively represent intermediate algorithmic steps, directly explaining the model’s internal mechanism. Its algorithmic task and iterative computation connect to composition and reasoning, but the main contribution is specifically about looped-transformer mechanisms.

    本文通过探测和干预残差流，表明权重共享的各次迭代会依次表示算法的中间步骤，直接解释了模型的内部机制。其算法任务和迭代计算与组合能力及推理相关，但主要贡献具体在于循环 Transformer 的机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Solving algorithmic tasks with many sequential steps typically requires scaling up transformer depth or chain-of-thought length, incurring unfavorable parameter and inference-compute costs, respectively. Looped transformers, which reuse one block of layers across many iterations, are poised to address this, since they scale effective depth without adding parameters or tokens. Yet, it remains unclear what each iteration is actually computing, or whether the loop merely simulates a deeper untied stack. Here, we study directed permutation traversal, in which a model follows $H$ hops from a starting node and reports the node it reaches, so every intermediate hop has a known ground truth. We find that a minimum effective depth is necessary to solve the task, beyond which the degree of weight tying becomes the determining factor. For instance, a looped transformer with a four-layer block iterated eight times solves the task in every seed, while an identically-trained untied transformer of the same effective depth never does, succeeding only with a lower learning rate or supervision of its intermediate layers. Probing and intervening on the residual stream, we find that the looped model advances through the intermediate nodes gradually, forming a staircase that adapts to its iteration budget, whereas the untied model, at that lower rate, exposes them only in its final layers. Taken together, our results recast looped transformers as iterative program learners, which allocate their iterations to successive steps of the algorithm and solve tasks that identically-trained untied models of the same effective depth do not. Code is available at https://github.com/magnus-sesodia/insidetheloop.

    中文

    解决包含许多顺序步骤的算法任务，通常需要增加 Transformer 的深度或思维链长度，分别带来不利的参数成本和推理计算成本。循环 Transformer 在多次迭代中复用同一个层块，有望解决这一问题，因为它能够在不增加参数或 token 的情况下扩展有效深度。然而，每次迭代究竟在计算什么，以及循环是否只是在模拟更深的非共享堆栈，仍不清楚。本文研究有向置换遍历任务：模型从一个起始节点出发，沿着 $H$ 条边前进并报告到达的节点，因此每一条中间边都有已知的真实答案。我们发现，解决该任务需要达到最低有效深度；超过这一深度后，权重共享程度便成为决定因素。例如，一个包含四层块、迭代八次的循环 Transformer 在每个随机种子下都能解决该任务，而采用相同训练方式、有效深度相同的非共享 Transformer 一次也未能解决；只有降低学习率或监督其中间层时，后者才能成功。通过探测并干预残差流，我们发现循环模型会逐步经过各个中间节点，形成一个随迭代预算调整的阶梯式过程；而在较低学习率下，非共享模型只在最后几层显露这些节点。综上，我们将循环 Transformer 重新视为迭代式程序学习器：它们将迭代分配给算法的连续步骤，并能解决采用相同训练方式、有效深度相同的非共享模型无法解决的任务。代码见 https://github.com/magnus-sesodia/insidetheloop。

    Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but often reduces the diversity of their reasoning behaviors. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of finite-sample learning dynamics and show that limited on-policy rollouts can progressively suppress semantically distinct but equally rewarded reasoning modes. Once a mode becomes sufficiently under-sampled, standard on-policy RLVR rarely recovers it. Motivated by this observation, we propose TAR, a Targeted Adaptive Replay framework that preserves diverse correct reasoning behaviors already present in the base policy. TAR constructs a compact memory bank of diverse base-model solutions and selectively replays them through an adaptive mechanism that activates only when stored behaviors are being suppressed during RLVR. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two Qwen2.5 model scales, TAR consistently achieves a better balance between reasoning performance and diversity preservation than existing diversity-preserving post-training methods, while substantially reducing the forgetting of correct base-model solutions.     Ding Zhu and Mohammad Mahdi Khalili

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops input-dependent activation steering from quadratic representation probes, proves when such interventions can be absorbed into model weights, and evaluates the method on behavior-control tasks. This directly advances representation-based model intervention, while the steering tasks and weight update do not substantively address composition, reasoning capability, or system organization.

    本文基于二次表征探针开发了依赖输入的激活引导，证明了此类干预可在何种条件下吸收到模型权重中，并在行为控制任务上评估该方法。这直接推进了基于表征的模型干预；而引导任务和权重更新并未实质涉及组合、推理能力或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Activation steering provides a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for controlling large language model behavior. Existing methods, however, often face a trade-off between efficiency and expressiveness: fixed steering vectors incur negligible inference overhead but cannot adapt to the current model input, whereas input-dependent nonlinear interventions provide greater flexibility at additional runtime cost. We introduce \textbf{WAQS} (\textbf{W}eight \textbf{A}bsorption for \textbf{Q}uadratic probing and affine \textbf{S}teering), a framework that obtains state-dependent steering, without additional inference-time computation. WAQS models a concept with a quadratic probe, whose gradient yields an affine, activation-dependent steering direction. We show that this affine intervention can be folded exactly into adjacent linear transformations through an offline weight update. Moreover, we prove that quadratic functions form the maximal class of smooth concept scores whose gradient-based interventions are affine and therefore exactly absorbable into linear layers. Under a Gaussian representation model, our formulation admits an interpretation as the difference of class-conditional Mahalanobis pulls and naturally generalizes linear discriminant and difference-in-means steering. To scale to high-dimensional representations, we introduce a low-rank parameterization of the quadratic term. Across truthfulness, refusal, and sycophancy steering tasks, quadratic steering matches or improves upon constant linear steering while preserving model utility, with the absorbed implementation introducing no additional inference-time operations. Our results suggest that quadratic probes provide a practical middle ground between static linear steering and computationally expensive dynamic nonlinear interventions.

    中文

    激活引导为控制大型语言模型行为提供了一种轻量级的微调替代方案。然而，现有方法往往面临效率与表达能力之间的权衡：固定引导向量几乎不会带来推理开销，但无法根据当前模型输入进行调整；依赖输入的非线性干预则更加灵活，但会增加运行时成本。我们提出 \textbf{WAQS}（用于二次探测与仿射引导的 \textbf{W}eight \textbf{A}bsorption for \textbf{Q}uadratic probing and affine \textbf{S}teering），这是一种无需增加推理时计算即可实现状态依赖引导的框架。WAQS 使用二次探针建模一个概念，其梯度会产生仿射的、依赖激活的引导方向。我们证明，这种仿射干预可以通过离线权重更新，精确地折叠进相邻的线性变换中。此外，我们证明，二次函数构成了梯度干预为仿射形式、因而能够精确吸收到线性层中的平滑概念评分函数的最大类别。在高斯表征模型下，我们的公式可以解释为两个类别条件马氏拉力之差，并自然推广了线性判别引导和均值差引导。为适用于高维表征，我们对二次项引入低秩参数化。在真实性、拒绝和谄媚引导任务中，二次引导在保持模型效用的同时达到或超过常量线性引导；吸收后的实现不会引入额外的推理时操作。我们的结果表明，二次探针为静态线性引导与计算开销较大的动态非线性干预提供了实用的折中方案。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Recursia improves a shared executable stack through trace-guided repairs, contracts, and validation, then tests whether those changes transfer to new robot task compositions.     Recursia 通过轨迹引导的修复、契约和验证改进共享可执行栈，随后检验这些改进能否迁移到新的机器人任务组合。组合迁移是其核心贡献，智能体执行架构也是其重要组成部分；摘要并未证明其对模型内部机制或推理有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Individually competent robot skills can fail when composed: tools may lack a required capability, completion signals may misrepresent physical progress, and one skill may leave a state that violates its successor's prerequisites. We introduce Recursia, a recursive self-improvement framework that treats the shared executable stack, rather than individual task programs, as the persistent unit of improvement. The stack integrates tools, skills with execution contracts, handoffs, and verifiers. Source-side execution traces guide failure attribution and the generation of missing tools or repairs to existing shared components. Generality checks, mechanism tests, and paired selection and regression gates determine which changes become the next parent. The resulting stack is frozen and reused through declarative task adapters, allowing source-derived changes to support new compositions without target-side code repair. Experiments cover LIBERO-Pro Long simulation and a physical Franka FR3 equipped with a Franka Hand. In simulation, Recursia improves success over ASPIRE by 5.8 percentage points under Pos perturbations and 15.1 points under Task perturbations. Across three physical compositional target tasks, it improves mean success over the Skill Document Only baseline by 40 percentage points. Analyses of constituent execution, candidate rejection, and inference drivers distinguish local mechanism improvements from complete task success and characterize the cost of feedback-conditioned orchestration. These results examine shared executable interfaces as a concrete mechanism for compositional transfer in robot programming.

    单独具备能力的机器人技能在组合使用时仍可能失效：工具可能缺少必需能力，完成信号可能无法准确反映物理进度，一个技能也可能留下违反后续技能前提条件的状态。我们提出 Recursia，这是一种递归自我改进框架，将共享可执行栈而非单个任务程序视为持续改进的对象。该栈整合工具、带有执行契约的技能、交接流程和验证器。源端执行轨迹用于指导故障归因，以及生成缺失工具或修复现有共享组件。通用性检查、机制测试以及成对的筛选与回归关卡共同决定哪些变更会成为下一版本的基础。随后，冻结后的栈通过声明式任务适配器重复使用，使源任务得出的改进能够支持新的技能组合，而无需在目标端修复代码。实验涵盖 LIBERO-Pro Long 仿真，以及配备 Franka Hand 的实体 Franka FR3。在仿真中，面对 Pos 扰动，Recursia 的成功率比 ASPIRE 高 5.8 个百分点；面对 Task 扰动，则高 15.1 个百分点。在三个实体组合目标任务上，其平均成功率比 Skill Document Only 基线高 40 个百分点。对各组成部分的执行情况、候选方案的拒绝情况以及推理驱动因素进行分析，可区分局部机制改进与完整任务成功，并刻画受反馈条件约束的编排成本。这些结果探讨了共享可执行接口如何作为机器人编程中实现组合迁移的具体机制。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ProbePO develops a budgeted probing method that redistributes reinforcement-learning credit across tokens in reasoning trajectories, improving accuracy across several models and benchmarks. Its central contribution directly advances training for reasoning, while rollout budgeting is incidental to the broader systems direction.

    ProbePO 提出一种预算受限的探测方法，在推理轨迹的 token 之间重新分配强化学习信用，并在多个模型和基准测试上提升准确率。其核心贡献直接推进了推理训练，而 rollout 预算管理只是其更广泛系统方向中的次要内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards assigns one terminal reward to an entire reasoning trajectory, obscuring how individual reasoning steps contributed to the outcome. GRPO broadcasts a group-normalized advantage to every response token, while finer-grained approaches often rely on dense auxiliary rollouts or branching schemes that can also alter the data used for policy updates. We cast the missing middle as budgeted measurement: with a limited rollout budget, which partial solutions should be evaluated, and how should their value estimates refine credit? ProbePO selects partial-solution states with a reward-free uncertainty score and estimates their expected verifier rewards under a capped continuation budget. ProbePO redistributes, rather than replaces, GRPO's trajectory-level advantage across tokens while preserving each trajectory's mean token-level advantage; probe continuations serve only as measurements. Across three DeepSeekMath and Qwen-family models spanning 1.5B-7B parameters, ProbePO consistently outperforms GRPO and achieves the highest accuracy among the four evaluated methods in 16 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons. Against dense-probing VinePPO on DeepSeekMath-7B, ProbePO achieves higher accuracy on all six benchmarks with 76% less end-to-end training time.

    Xinye Yang, Zhenyang Liu, Yuxuan Wang, Yuanyuan Lei

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RLAWM trains physics models to represent the problem’s axiomatic world separately from solving within it, improving reasoning and transfer across difficulty and domains. This directly targets reasoning development, but the abstract does not investigate internal mechanisms, composition, or agent systems.

    RLAWM 训练物理模型将问题的公理化世界表征与在该世界中求解区分开来，从而提升推理能力以及跨难度和领域的迁移能力。这项工作直接针对推理能力发展，但摘要未研究内部机制、组合性或智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent research-level physics-reasoning benchmarks for LLMs reveal a failure mode that lies not in knowledge or execution, but in modeling the world being reasoned about. Models often silently alter given quantities, fabricate laws, or inject unstated assumptions to force a problem into familiar patterns, and then reason inside this corrupted world. We define this premise-level divergence as modeling drift: the gap between a model's internal axiomatic world model (AWM) and the true physical world specified in the problem. Although RLVR and PRM have yielded substantial gains in mathematics and code, their reward shapes do not directly supervise world modeling in axiomatic domains such as physics. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Axiomatic World Modeling (RLAWM), which optimizes the policy by penalizing divergence between its inferred axiomatic world model and the true physics world. RLAWM probes physics reasoning at two hierarchical levels (modeling and solving), each scored by a physically grounded reward. The modeling reward targets abstract knowledge formulation, evaluating whether the model captures the true axiomatic world before attempting calculation. The solving reward targets instantiated knowledge reasoning, checking whether the model's concrete derivation remains consistent with the axiomatic world. This two-level structure separates what world the model believes it is reasoning in from how it reasons within that world. The framework operates exclusively during training, with no extra cost during inference. RLAWM improves performance by up to +12.2 points on PhysReason and +5.2 on PHYSICS over the baseline. It also generalizes zero-shot across difficulty, source, and domain, with a 2.45x gain and +10 points over the strongest baseline on olympiad-level physics and math.

    MLP neurons in transformer language models are widely understood to be polysemantic, motivating transcoders - sparse, learned approximations of MLP layers - as interpretable replacement models for mechanistic analysis. However, recent work shows that MLP neurons can be used to recover sparse, interpretable circuits (Arora et al. 2026, Ye et al. 2025), raising the question of whether transcoders are necessary for circuit analysis. We define neuron features as transcoder features whose weights are strongly aligned with individual MLP neurons, and show that they account for a substantial fraction of active features in late layers across 13 open-source transcoders. Only neuron features have a stable correspondence with something in the underlying MLP: other features vary more between training runs, do not match the MLP's Jacobian, and change less significantly from their random initialization.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We study feature vectors: directions in a language model's activation space that correspond to human-interpretable concepts, such as honesty or deception. Existing unsupervised methods like sparse autoencoders attempt to recover the whole feature space, often at the cost of feature quality and interpretability. We take a more pragmatic route: focusing on concepts relevant to AI safety and alignment, we generate synthetic concept-antagonist story pairs and use the difference of their mean model activations as a feature vector. We scale this approach to 1,036 alignment-relevant concepts using 2M synthetic stories across multiple languages and genres, which we publicly release. Across six models from three model families, our feature vectors reliably generalize to detecting their corresponding concepts in chat dialogues and web text. They form an interpretable geometry shared across models and can causally steer model behavior when injected into activations. We further use these features to analyze model representations during jailbreak attacks, mathematical and agentic reasoning. Our targeted feature construction thus offers a scalable route to studying concepts in language models, potentially extending to millions of features across arbitrary domains.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The safety capabilities of large language models (LLMs) are highly uneven across different languages, often allowing cross-lingual attacks to bypass safety guardrails. Existing alignment methods predominantly rely on external alignment signals and provide limited insight into underlying neuron-level mechanisms, making it difficult to provide a unified internal target for cross-lingual safety interventions. To address this, we analyze cross-lingual safety behavior at the neuron level and identify a compact set of safety-related neurons shared across languages, termed the safety kernel (SK). Specifically, we first utilize multilingual parallel safe and unsafe prompts to compute safety contrast with activation responsiveness (SCAR) scores, identifying language-wise safety-neuron candidates from internal activation patterns. We then intersect the resulting language-wise safety-neuron sets to obtain the SK, and validate its functional relevance to cross-lingual safety behavior through activation suppression and activation-state transfer interventions. Finally, building on the SK coordinates, we introduce SK-Masked LoRA, which constrains LoRA adaptation to the feed-forward network (FFN) output dimensions corresponding to the SK, thereby focusing safety-related changes on the cross-lingually shared neuron coordinates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SK-Masked LoRA substantially reduces attack success rates across multiple languages, including languages excluded from SK discovery, while intervening on only a small fraction of internal neuron coordinates and producing generally limited changes in the model's general capabilities.

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves mathematical reasoning, but what it adds to the base model remains unclear. We investigate this through a sequence of generation-time interventions on Qwen3-4B-Base, measuring how much of its RL-trained counterpart's gain each intervention recovers on 120 AIME problems. Power sampling with the same 8,192-token output limit brings no gain beyond greedy decoding. Yet borrowing the RL model's token only where the two models' greedy choices differ, roughly 4% of generated positions, recovers 90.5% of the pass@1 gain, with similar recovery across three model pairs on MATH-500. We find that even a single opening token has a substantial effect: forcing the base model to begin with "Alright" recovers 35% of the RL gain. The opening alone is insufficient, however. Later replacements after the same opening add another 5.2 percentage points to pass@1, and the fixed rules we test for inserting reflective words such as "Wait" do not reproduce this benefit. Sparse replacement also retains much of the base model's diversity while staying close to the RL model at pass@1. At k=256, it solves 67.5% of the problems, significantly more than the RL model (61.4%) and a mixture of whole responses matched in pass@1 (61.45%). The comparison is at equal attempt counts rather than equal compute, since rl-replace consults both models at every decoding step. These results show that the opening can recover a meaningful part of the RL gain, but a larger contribution comes from later choices, which can be borrowed while retaining much of the base model's diversity. Code is available at https://github.com/CyrusZhang04/WhatRLBrings.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion language models (dLLMs) are emerging as an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language models, yet dLLM agents largely inherit an interaction protocol designed for AR generation: once intermediate state is written, later observations can only be incorporated by appending more text. This is a poor match to a defining capability of dLLMs -- reconstructing earlier text conditioned on context that appears both before and after it. We ask whether this capability can support a different agent-state paradigm in which intermediate planning state is directly revisable as evidence arrives. We introduce DiffuPlan, a diffusion search agent that maintains a single editable planning state and reconstructs only the affected steps when later evidence resolves an entity or changes the search route. To support variable-length revisions, we introduce Expansion-Partition Marginalization (EPM), which marginalizes over equivalent expansion paths. We further adapt diffusion trajectory RL to multi-turn search. Across four multi-hop QA benchmarks, DiffuPlan achieves 50.24 average F1, outperforming strong AR search agents. More importantly, under identical data and training, editable planning state improves the diffusion agent by 2.44 F1 versus only 0.47 for its AR source model. These results show that dLLMs need not imitate append-only AR agents: revising committed state is a distinct agentic advantage.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent systems promise to solve problems by bringing together information beyond the reach of any individual agent. Retrieval and tool use can distribute this information across agents, making communication essential to collaboration. A central challenge is keeping crucial evidence visible in each agent's context as messages accumulate. Repeated information can crowd out rare, decisive evidence. Models of cortical circuits suggest a principle for addressing this imbalance: inhibition can selectively suppress shared inputs while preserving sensitivity to weaker signals. We adapt this principle into inhibitory message passing, a training-free communication router that cancels redundant evidence separately for each evidence sentence and receiver. Each round, it forwards evidence sentences restated in agents' messages, delivering each at most once to receivers whose own evidence lacks it and excluding the senders' reasoning and answers. Against standard message passing, accuracy in peer groups rose by 39-77 percentage points across three benchmarks, and tokens per run fell by 10-46%. Gains held across seven open models spanning four to thirty-two billion parameters and two commercial models, in groups up to sixty-four agents, and across multi-agent architectures including peer-to-peer, orchestrator-worker, and multilevel hierarchical organizations. These findings support a scalable design pattern for more accurate and token-efficient multi-agent reasoning.

    多智能体系统有望通过汇集超出任何单个智能体能力范围的信息来解决问题。检索和工具使用可以将这些信息分散到不同智能体，使通信成为协作的关键。一个核心挑战是，随着消息不断累积，如何让关键证据始终出现在每个智能体的上下文中。重复信息可能挤占稀少但具有决定性的证据。皮层回路模型提出了一种解决这种失衡的原则：抑制可以有选择地压制共享输入，同时保留对较弱信号的敏感性。我们将这一原则用于抑制式消息传递，这是一种无需训练的通信路由器，针对每条证据句子和每个接收者分别消除冗余证据。每一轮中，它会转发智能体消息中重述的证据句子；对于自身证据中没有该信息的接收者，每条证据最多发送一次，同时排除发送者的推理过程和答案。与标准消息传递相比，在三个基准测试中，协作组的准确率提高了39至77个百分点，每次运行的 token 数则减少了10%至46%。这些提升在七个参数规模从40亿到320亿的开放模型和两个商用模型上均成立，适用于最多64个智能体的群组，也适用于点对点、编排者-工作者和多层级层次组织等多智能体架构。这些发现支持一种可扩展的设计模式，使多智能体推理更加准确且节省 token。

    Bellman Language Models: Solving the Recurring Decisions of LLM Agents

    Bellman 语言模型：解决 LLM 智能体反复遇到的决策

    Adarsh Vatsa, William Eiers

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper learns a discrete-state MDP policy from agent workflows and uses it as a controller to reuse solved decisions, reducing model calls while improving task performance. This is a core agent-system contribution; decision optimization relates partially to reasoning, but it does not study how models internally reason or compose representations.

    该论文从智能体工作流中学习离散状态 MDP 策略，并将其用作控制器来重复使用已求解的决策，从而在提升任务表现的同时减少模型调用。这是对智能体系统的核心贡献；决策优化与推理有部分关联，但论文没有研究模型如何在内部进行推理或组合表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A general observation in agentic workflows, especially bounded ones, is that the decision space of the LLM, when we separate a decision from generation, starts approaching saturation: the agent meets the same states again and again, and after enough conversations it stops meeting new ones. LLMs generally don't treat these decisions as an optimization problem and instead re-derive them from their context/prompt on every turn. We show that treating decision making within reasonable bounds as an optimization problem, solving it once, and reusing the solved decisions can often make an agent faster, cheaper and more reliable. Our approach, which we call Discretize, Then Decide, starts from data such as the workflow's own logs or, when none exists, runs of the LLM agent itself. It reads each conversation into discrete states and estimates the probability of each outcome and the cost of each move, until no new states appear and the probabilities stop changing. It then solves the resulting Markov decision process. The solution runs as a controller around the model, sending moves whose content is fixed in the state, such as a tool call or a templated reply, and any state it hasn't seen is sent back to the LLM. We call an LLM run this way a Bellman language model (BLM), after Richard Bellman's equation for the best move in each state. On $\tau^2$-bench telecom, the controller with no model solves 79% of tasks. As a BLM, Qwen3.8-27B, an open model, goes from 29% to 96% with 93% fewer model calls. For Claude Opus 5.5, which solves 96% of tasks on its own, running it as a BLM cuts model calls and cost per task by about 98% and lets it solve 2 more tasks. On InventoryBench, the solved policy with no model beats every published method. Where the hard part is writing content rather than choosing moves, such as resolving SymPy issues, few decisions can be solved in advance, and a BLM helps little.

    中文

    在智能体工作流中，尤其是有界工作流中，一个普遍现象是：当我们将决策与生成区分开来时，LLM 的决策空间开始趋于饱和：智能体一次又一次遇到相同状态，经过足够多轮对话后，它便不再遇到新状态。LLM 通常不会将这些决策视为优化问题，而是在每一轮中根据上下文/提示重新推导。我们表明，将合理范围内的决策视为优化问题，求解一次并重复使用已求出的决策，往往能让智能体更快、更便宜且更可靠。我们将这种方法称为“先离散化，再决策”（Discretize, Then Decide）。它从工作流自身的日志等数据开始；若没有此类数据，则使用 LLM 智能体自身的运行记录。该方法将每段对话解析为离散状态，并估计每种结果的概率和每个动作的成本，直至不再出现新状态且概率不再变化。随后，它求解由此得到的马尔可夫决策过程。求解结果作为模型周围的控制器运行，发送内容已由状态确定的动作，例如工具调用或模板化回复；对于尚未见过的状态，则交由 LLM 处理。我们将以这种方式运行的 LLM 称为 Bellman 语言模型（BLM），名称源自 Richard Bellman 关于每个状态下最佳动作的方程。在 $\tau^2$-bench telecom 上，不使用模型的控制器可解决 79% 的任务。作为 BLM，开放模型 Qwen3.8-27B 的任务解决率从 29% 提升至 96%，模型调用次数减少 93%。对于单独运行时可解决 96% 任务的 Claude Opus 5.5，将其作为 BLM 运行可使模型调用次数和单任务成本降低约 98%，并多解决 2 个任务。在 InventoryBench 上，不使用模型的已求解策略胜过所有已发表的方法。如果难点在于撰写内容而非选择动作，例如解决 SymPy 问题，那么很少有决策能预先求解，BLM 的帮助也就不大。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Activation steering has emerged as an effective and precise way to influence the behaviours of language models. However, composing multiple steering directions to control several behaviours simultaneously remains challenging, particularly in multilingual settings and with training-free steering vectors. We address this challenge with contextual steering, jointly training gates that adapt the strength of fixed steering directions to the current hidden state and interactions between interventions. Across a broad range of languages, behavioural attributes, and models, our approach outperforms constant-strength steering and four strong baselines, including prompting. It also better preserves general knowledge and keeps the model's internal computation closer to that of the prompted model. Our analysis further shows how jointly trained gates adapt their contributions during composition, explaining the mechanisms underlying effective compositional steering.

    一种通过对称性匹配减少稀疏自编码器盲点的方法

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly studies how SAE training changes feature-basis orientation and representation-level sensitivity to semantically distinct inputs, with held-out tests of downstream discriminability. Its safety applications do not establish substantive contributions to composition, reasoning, or model and agent systems.

    该论文直接研究 SAE 训练如何改变特征基方向以及表征层面对语义不同输入的敏感性，并通过留出测试检验下游区分能力。其安全应用并未构成对组合性、推理或模型与智能体系统的实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language models can treat semantically distinct inputs as interchangeable at the representation level, creating blind spots that standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not target. In safety-critical settings such as clinical dosage extraction, legal clause interpretation, or financial amount verification, such failures can propagate silently into downstream decisions. We study this problem as one of feature-basis orientation. Building on a symmetry-matching view from algebraic error-detection theory, we add a differentiable $V_{\mathrm{Gini}}$ regularisation term to SAE training that penalises uneven perturbation response within a specified family. Across GPT-2, Gemma 2, and Qwen 2.5, a frozen multi-seed evaluation shows that $V$-regularisation raises both relative and absolute lower-tail responses while reducing response-profile imbalance, with no material general-text reconstruction degradation. JumpReLU and minimum description length (MDL) objectives remain close to the Standard SAE profile under the same protocol. Family-geometry controls show that the effect is not explained by template duplication or a single dominant perturbation family, and held-out probes plus null-calibrated separation tests evaluate how far the representation-level change carries to downstream discriminability. A zero-shot audit on out-of-distribution clinical radiology minimal pairs finds the relative weak-tail lift in all evaluated model-by-family cells, not perfectly rank-aligned with the trained statistic, and a held-out family audit finds it on family kinds never used in training. Together, the results show that perturbation-aware SAE training can reorient feature bases toward safety-relevant input changes while leaving downstream validation as a separate empirical step.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM planning research has traditionally focused on discrete-state domains, where actions form a finite, enumerable set. Existing LLM planning frameworks largely assume actions are enumerable, modeling planning as a search process over candidate actions. However, in continuous-state domains, where actions form a continuum and cannot be enumerated, this assumption breaks down. We find a remedy in Newell and Simon's Means-Ends Analysis (MEA), a general problem-solving technique rooted in heuristics from human psychology. We develop Medaka, an MEA-inspired structured prompting framework that encourages recursive goal decomposition, algebraic derivation, and per-step state tracking. To evaluate native LLM planning abilities in continuous-state domains, we develop Liquidworld, a systematic testbed on liquid mixing. On Liquidworld, Medaka can improve performance across model families, suggesting that classical means-ends analysis elicits LLM-native reasoning abilities that are helpful for continuous-state planning.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Epi’s main contribution is a persistent, self-improving research agent that uses hierarchical memory, branching, and review to sustain investigations across sessions, with substantial mathematical and optimization results. This directly advances agent systems and strongly advances reasoning through autonomous problem solving; compositionality is only incidental to its varied tasks.

    Epi 的主要贡献是一种持久、自我改进的研究智能体，它利用分层记忆、分支探索和审查跨会话持续开展调查，并取得了重要的数学和优化成果。这直接推动了智能体系统的发展，并通过自主解决问题显著推动了推理能力；组合性对于其多样化任务而言只是附带特征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We present \'{E}pi, an autonomous research agent that sustains investigations across model sessions and evolves its methods through accumulated experience. \'{E}pi combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review to maintain research continuity, learn from experiments, and explore and revisit alternative approaches. Its experiments run across session boundaries, and a fixed verifier evaluates their outputs. \'{E}pi produced 120 record-setting results, comprising 20 numerical bound records across 12 families and 100 construction records across eight families. These include an approximately 84-fold narrower interval for the $n$-queens constant and a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension. Exact dual certificates establish that the Cohn-Elkies linear-programming bound cannot be sharp in dimensions 10 and 11. Beyond numerical improvements, \'{E}pi gives a computer-assisted proof of Tuza's conjecture for split graphs with an eight-vertex clique part and at most three triangle-active neighborhood types, with arbitrary multiplicities. We extend this research process to algorithmic coding with \'{E}pi-turbo, a lightweight configuration that develops executable solvers for tasks including vehicle routing, scheduling and production planning. On 30 FrontierOR tasks, \'{E}pi-turbo achieves a 5.4% higher total benchmark score than Codex at 64% of its model cost, using the same underlying model and reasoning effort. \'{E}pi is designed to support human understanding by connecting computational results to explicit methods and mathematical arguments that researchers can examine and build upon.
